s.en: Displays boot-time emergency log message in full screen

o.en: Print a short help text and exit.
Print a short version string and exit.
When specified, systemd-bsod waits continuously for changes in the journal if it does not find any emergency messages on the initial attempt. Added in version 255.

Specify the TTY to output to. By default, systemd-bsod will automatically find a free VT to display the message on. If this option is specified a TTY may be selected explicitly. Use --tty=/dev/tty to direct output to the terminal the command is invoked on. Added in version 256.
